items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They had a guy out of Chicago named Oscar Hollins(?) that played clarinet and piano that was pretty good, and another guy from Chicago named Bill Hoy(?) played drums.

ctx.x: Well, they was pretty popular in Seattle. They had... Yeah, they had a couple of pretty good bands. They had a guy out of Chicago named Oscar Hollins(?) that played clarinet and piano that was pretty good, and another guy from Chicago named Bill Hoy(?) played drums. Some other names will come to me.
All this time, really, that you'd...like from the medicine almost clean through, you'd more or less sort of laid down playing Dixieland music, hadn't you?
